Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding more than 0.7% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 1.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Proofpoint ( PFPT ) jumped out to a 12% gain after reporting non-GAAP Q4 net income of $0.51 per share, up from $0.37 per share during the same quarter last year and beating consensus estimates by $0.16 per share. Revenue rose 35% year-over-year, also topping Street views.
In other sector news:
(+) Symantec ( SYMC ) rose 9% after late Thursday reporting fiscal Q3 net income of $0.44 per share on $1.22 billion in revenue, exceeding the analyst means by $0.05 per share and $40 million, respectively.
(-) Celestica ( CLS ) dropped almost 18% on Friday after the electronics contract manufacturer missed Wall Street estimates with its Q4 earnings results. It also issued a mixed Q1 forecast and received a downgrade to neutral from outperform at Macquarie.
